Find a member | Engineers Ireland

Search our membership database with the known engineer's name to find out whether they are an

All members returned in searches are current members and have satisfied the requirements to achieve membership or a Registered Professional Title.

Information supplied is limited and abides by the rules of Data Protection. The Find A Member search is to be used solely to verify if an engineer is a member of Engineers Ireland - due to GDPR compliance, it is not possible to find contact information.

If you have any questions or need further assistance to find a member, please get in touch below.

Please ensure that your profile is up-to-date in your Member Dashboard. In the My Profile section, click Personal Details to edit your details, upload a profile picture, add in your LinkedIn URL and more. For this information to be visible in the Find a Member database, please tick the box in the top right of the Personal Details section 'Edit Details Available in Public Search'.
